title: Three-Fold Composition of Rational and Radical Functions
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Write a simplified formula for (f o g o h)(x), given f(x) = (x + 2) / (3 - x), g(x) = x^2 / (x^2 + 1), and h(x) = sqrt(2 - x).

steps.title: Compute the Inner Composition g(h(x))
steps.explanation: For x <= 2, h(x) = sqrt(2 - x) is real and (sqrt(2 - x))^2 = 2 - x. Substituting into g(x) = x^2 / (x^2 + 1) gives (2 - x) / (3 - x).
steps.why: Squaring a real principal square root recovers the non-negative radicand 2 - x.

steps.title: Substitute g(h(x)) into the Outer Function f
steps.explanation: Replace x in f(x) = (x + 2) / (3 - x) with the rational expression g(h(x)) = (2 - x) / (3 - x).
steps.why: Direct substitution of the inner composite expression into f.

steps.title: Clear the Complex Fraction and Simplify
steps.explanation: Multiply both numerator and denominator by (3 - x) (which is non-zero for all x <= 2), then distribute and collect like terms.
steps.why: Multiplying numerator and denominator by the common factor 3 - x preserves equivalence on x <= 2.
